label: generic interior pilot in family-specific reduced physical coordinates (NOT a uniform prior; representative pilot, not a marginalization)

reduced_coordinates.E2: (x/Lx mod 1, y/Ly mod 1) modulo half-turn p->-p; quotient distance min over sign and integer shifts
reduced_coordinates.E7: eta_y = dist(y, (L1y/2)Z)/L1y in [0,1/4] (glide planes at y=0 and y=L1y/2)
reduced_coordinates.E8: eta_x = dist(x, LAx Z)/LAx in [0,1/2]; eta_y = dist(y, (LCy/2)Z)/LCy in [0,1/4]

E2.exclude: reject if within 0.05 (torus distance) of a half-turn fixed point (0,0),(0,1/2),(1/2,0),(1/2,1/2)
E2.min_sep_meaning: anti-duplication design constraint (not a coverage guarantee)

E7.exclude: none (box excludes glide planes eta=0 and midpoint eta=1/4)
E7.min_sep_meaning: anti-duplication design constraint (not a coverage guarantee)

E8.exclude: none (box excludes reflection planes and midpoints)
E8.min_sep_meaning: anti-duplication design constraint (not a coverage guarantee)

lift_rule: irrelevant coordinates fixed at generic fractions (0.31, 0.37, 0.42)
